# Types and data: gin, named types and stored types

How every shape is written with gin, named types with methods, and stored types whose records the hub keeps.

- [Types with gin](context:fs/authoring.gin): Every shape is a gin type made with g; Infer gives its TypeScript type.
- [Named types and methods](context:fs/authoring.named-types): Named types (type()) and the methods on them.
- [Stored types and the data system](context:fs/authoring.data): Stored types: records the hub keeps, checks, versions and searches; ctx.data to find, save and remove them.

Fns for this: fn:fs/read, fn:fs/write, fn:fs/edit, fn:fs/bash.
